scope: Exact fetched reused qualification checkout; not a fresh clone, whole browser gate, ordinary-time footage or hardware measurement

reports.head: ba6fe9fa6a93cfadf075bf085a875dc0f63c6050
reports.method:
Bounded Hearthwater woodland visibility check, using an isolated local profile.

Oren's kit and Earth entry use visible controls; supported moveTo/.05s ticks
accelerate travel without body, gear or quest grants. V selects both cameras;
right-drag and wheel inspect the surroundings. Screenshots are actual software
WebGL with controlled frames and ordinary RAF disabled. A synchronous tree-only
ablation proves visible contribution and exact
restoration; it is a test control, not an alternate playable build. No movie,
personal storage, human enjoyment or hardware-performance claim.

reports.head: 15de8939e786e06ac7a15799677613bcf22aef16
reports.method:
ET07 visible-control qualification using a disposable loopback character.

Capture mode disables ordinary RAF. Production moveTo and accepted .05s ticks
accelerate travel and advance declared exchanges; native UI, Tab/F/3, V and
settings controls make the decisions. No pose, inventory, damage or score grants.
The bow is command-crafted from actually gathered materials. Whole Chromium
restarts reuse only this caller's temporary profile. Screenshots are controlled
software-WebGL evidence, not human pacing, ordinary-RAF footage or RTX evidence.
Run through tools/browser_budget.py; browser allocation stays serial.
